initial_regressions: The first full run identified three old quantitative assertions that no longer described the revised controller: 12 s shell yaw settlement; universally better XY endpoint error with preparation; old first-load slip reduction percentages. The final tests separately require sustained strict settlement by 60 s, retain fixed-target/physical/absolute-error guards, and test preload activation and actual slip reduction. Changed observations and half-step checks are preserved in transient_checks.json and transfer_check.json.
